note.zh: 本周核实 30 个直飞方向；官方公开低价页观察到 19 个低于 $100 的 Discount Den 报价。其余 11 个方向在本轮公开页面中未观察到合格报价，动态日历未能完整核实，因此不代表无航班或无低价。公开报价不是 GoWild 库存。
note.en: This week reviewed 30 nonstop directions and observed 19 Discount Den quotes below $100 on Frontier public deal pages. No qualifying quote was observed for the other 11 directions; the full dynamic calendar could not be completely verified, so this does not mean no flight or low fare exists. Public quotes are not GoWild inventory.
